offering_description.value: Operates an AI-driven lending network that connects banks, credit unions and fintech lenders with investors and funding partners to originate, fund and service consumer loans. Sells to lending institutions and institutional investors, earning network fees, servicing fees and interest on loans it holds.

primary_products.value: auto loans; personal loans; point-of-sale financing; AI lending software

primary_services.value: loan servicing; AI credit decisioning; loan origination support; investor capital placement

customer_segment.value: B2B: banks, credit unions, fintech lenders, retailers and institutional investors

end_markets.value: consumer lending; auto finance; banking; retail

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: per-loan network fees paid by lending partners; commissions or management fees: servicing and management fees on investor-funded loan portfolios; interest or premiums: interest income on loans it holds on its balance sheet
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; commissions or management fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: AI lending platform that partners use to underwrite and fund loans; financial intermediary: matches loan originators with investors and takes in capital to fund loans, sold to lenders and investors

geography_served.value: US national: US consumer credit market, with partner lenders across the country

specialization.value: related lines: auto, personal and point-of-sale consumer loans sharing one AI lending network

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: bank and fintech lending partners that originate loans on its platform; direct sales: institutional investors and funding partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer lending, fair lending and servicing rules from CFPB and state regulators

notes: Product mix and fee structure may have shifted over time, so this description is based on general knowledge.
